_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from Argentine Ministerio Público Fiscal reports. Only defendants with an individually stated drug count are included. Rosario verdict date is explicit; Córdoba December verdicts are dated by publication because exact judgment dates are not stated. Unified penalties are distinguished from the new case sentences. ARG country claims describe historical conduct, not current custody or location. No precise sites/routes, inferred person links, or unlicensed images.
